中国探月与深空探测网 (CLEP)
嫦娥三号 — 中文维基百科

China's first lunar landing — the first soft landing anywhere on the Moon in 37 years. The Chang'e 3 lander is still alive, making it the longest-surviving lunar lander ever. Yutu drove 114 m before its drive mechanism failed, but its instruments continued returning science data.
Re-established robotic landing capability after a decades-long pause — the foundation for the sample-return missions (Chang'e 5, 6) that informed Mars Sample Return architecture.

Chang'e 3 landed in Mare Imbrium on December 14, 2013 — China's first soft landing on the Moon and the first lunar landing of any kind in 37 years (since Luna 24). Deployed the Yutu rover, which drove ~114 m before a control failure froze it in place for the remaining ~30 lunar days of survival. Confirmed China as the third nation with surface assets on the Moon.
